purpose: Measure whether the published strongest sub-billion-parameter MiniCheck model clears the unchanged WiCE quality gates before any PRME integration

evaluation.decision_rule: All unchanged WiCE gates must pass before integration. Preserve failure without threshold tuning on this observed cohort.

selection.disclosure: Generic NLI and MiniCheck DeBERTa WiCE outcomes were observed before this selection. Flan-T5 weights, binary token mapping, input prefix, and 0.5 threshold were published beforehand; no score-dependent changes are allowed.
selection.safetensors_provenance: Pinned verified Hugging Face conversion commit refs/pr/1; the official main repository distributes the same model as PyTorch pickle weights.

claim_boundary: Passing would establish model capacity on WiCE oracle retrieval only. It would not establish safe PRME integration, contradiction handling, retrieval quality, untouched generalization, or product leadership.
